blurb: Guests enjoy a 45-minute to 1-hour hot air balloon flight at sunrise over the Willamette Valley with views of Mt. Hood and the Cascade Mountains. Flights operate daily from March through October, weather permitting. After landing, guests celebrate with a traditional toast.
